tx-harris-2026-coa14-chief-jewell-kevin.name: Kevin Jewell
tx-harris-2026-coa14-chief-jewell-kevin.bio: Justice on the Fourteenth Court of Appeals since 2016; former litigation and appellate shareholder at a Houston law firm.

positions.stance: Describes himself as a judge who upholds the rule of law and "will never legislate from my seat on the bench."
Says his role is "to apply the law as written and to never privilege one party over another due to personal preference."
Believes "a judge's core job is to deliver justice for all and give all parties the fair day in court they deserve."
Says that regardless of personal beliefs or partisan affiliation, he will work to ensure "our courts never become yet another political arena."
Pledges to "defend the rule of law and to treat everyone who comes before the Fourteenth Court of Appeals with fairness and dignity."

tx-harris-2026-coa14-chief-landau-sarah.name: Sarah Beth Landau
tx-harris-2026-coa14-chief-landau-sarah.bio: Former justice on the First Court of Appeals (2019-2024); former federal public defender and Harris County Public Defender's Office attorney.

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p3-frankfort-todd.name: Todd Frankfort
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p3-frankfort-todd.bio: Houston attorney in private practice for over 30 years, Board Certified in Family Law.

positions.stance: Says every ruling should be "based on the Constitution, the existing law, and the precedents found in prior cases."
"It is not my job to change the law; that is what the legislature is for."
Shares "the conservative values of judicial restraint and strict interpretation of the laws as written" and "will not allow judges to legislate from the bench."

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p3-rivas-molloy-vero.name: Veronica Rivas-Molloy
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p3-rivas-molloy-vero.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals; previously practiced complex litigation and appellate law for 20 years.

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p4-gunn-david.name: David Gunn
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p4-gunn-david.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals, appointed by Governor Abbott; former appellate lawyer at Beck Redden LLP and Hilshire Village city council member.

positions.stance: His judicial philosophy is "a commitment to interpret the law faithfully and impartially, with a deep respect for the letter and spirit of the constitution."
Believes "the law, when correctly applied, serves as the cornerstone of a fair and just society."
Says his rulings reflect "a balanced consideration of legal precedents and the evolving needs of the community," aiming for "clear, reasoned, and just decisions."

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p4-countiss-julie.name: Julie Countiss
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p4-countiss-julie.bio: Former First Court of Appeals justice (six years); former Assistant County Attorney with the Harris County Attorney's Office.

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p5-caird-jessica.name: Jessica Caird
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p5-caird-jessica.bio: Harris County Assistant District Attorney for 26 years and Appellate Division Chief since 2021.

positions.stance: Believes the U.S. and Texas Constitutions "must be interpreted as written because they stand as the will of the people."
"The job of a judge is not to ignore or create the law, but to faithfully apply it as written by the Texas Legislature and as enshrined in the Constitution."

tx-harris-2026-coa1-p5-guerra-amy.name: Amy Guerra
tx-harris-2026-coa1-p5-guerra-amy.bio: Justice on the First Court of Appeals since 2021; former Houston municipal judge and business litigation partner.

tx-harris-2026-coa14-p7-demond-william.name: William Demond
tx-harris-2026-coa14-p7-demond-william.bio: Former staff attorney for the Fifth Court of Appeals (2023-2026) and constitutional rights attorney in Houston.

tx-harris-2026-dist55-payne-latosha.name: Latosha Lewis Payne
tx-harris-2026-dist55-payne-latosha.bio: Presiding Judge of the 55th Civil District Court since 2019.

tx-harris-2026-dist113-sullivan-paul.name: Paul M. Sullivan
tx-harris-2026-dist113-sullivan-paul.bio: Houston civil attorney licensed in Texas state and federal courts.

tx-harris-2026-dist113-collier-rabeea.name: Rabeea Collier
tx-harris-2026-dist113-collier-rabeea.bio: Judge of the 113th Judicial District Court; previously represented individuals, non-profits and businesses in Harris County courts.

tx-harris-2026-dist157-garrison-tanya.name: Tanya Garrison
tx-harris-2026-dist157-garrison-tanya.bio: Judge of the 157th District Court since 2018.

tx-harris-2026-dist189-christopher-vance.name: Vance Christopher
tx-harris-2026-dist189-christopher-vance.bio: Board-certified civil trial lawyer for more than 40 years; former Harris County Assistant District Attorney.

tx-harris-2026-dist189-craft-tamika.name: Tamika "Tami" Craft
tx-harris-2026-dist189-craft-tamika.bio: Judge of the 189th Civil District Court; attorney licensed in Texas since 2003.

tx-harris-2026-dist190-miller-beau.name: Beau Miller
tx-harris-2026-dist190-miller-beau.bio: Judge of the 190th Judicial District Court since 2018; former civil and constitutional litigator.

tx-harris-2026-dist234-reeder-lauren.name: Lauren Reeder
tx-harris-2026-dist234-reeder-lauren.bio: Judge of the 234th Civil District Court; Administrative Judge for the Civil Division in 2025.

tx-harris-2026-dist270-staley-brian.name: Brian Staley
tx-harris-2026-dist270-staley-brian.bio: Attorney with over 29 years of legal experience and small business owner.

tx-harris-2026-dist270-davis-dedra.name: Dedra Davis
tx-harris-2026-dist270-davis-dedra.bio: Presiding judge of the 270th District Court since 2018.

tx-harris-2026-dist281-weems-christine.name: Christine Weems
tx-harris-2026-dist281-weems-christine.bio: Sitting judge of the 281st Civil District Court.

tx-harris-2026-dist295-roth-donna.name: Donna Roth
tx-harris-2026-dist295-roth-donna.bio: Judge of the 295th Civil District Court, elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022.
